meta.proyek: Skripsi Takar - aplikasi web manajemen resep dan standardisasi operasional kedai kopi (FastAPI + Vue.js) dengan rekomendasi AI
meta.tujuan: Daftar persamaan yang boleh dipakai di skripsi (PANDUAN_PENULISAN.md 0.6 dan 3). Hanya entri 'confirmed' yang boleh dicetak sebagai persamaan bernomor; kunci sitasi hanya dari referensi_terverifikasi.json.

struktur.confirmed: Rumus yang didukung sumber di pool dan dibuka langsung. evidence_snippet = kutipan verbatim (persamaan ditulis linear bila sumbernya MathML/PDF; '[...]' = lompatan teks; '[hlm. x]' = penanda halaman; superskrip = nomor rujukan sumber). evidence_form menandai apakah rumus tercetak sebagai persamaan atau hanya definisi verbal. additional_evidence = sumber pendamping yang juga dibuka.
struktur.rejected: Bentuk/atribusi yang TIDAK boleh dipakai beserta alasannya.
struktur.missing: Rumus tanpa sumber di pool yang dapat dibuka; bila ada sumber di luar pool yang mendukung, buktinya dicatat di candidate_evidence dan metadatanya di candidate_sources (belum ditambahkan ke pool).
struktur.candidate_sources: Usulan sumber baru dengan DOI yang diverifikasi di Crossref; TIDAK ditambahkan ke referensi_terverifikasi.json.

meta.aturan_sitasi: BINUS: 1-5 penulis \citet*{}/\citep*{}; >= 6 penulis \citet{}/\citep{} (tercetak 'dkk.'); tanpa \cite{} dan tanpa 'et al.' manual. Field 'cite' pada tiap entri sudah diperiksa terhadap jumlah penulis di pool.
meta.metode: Setiap sumber dibuka pada 2026-09-30: teks lengkap Europe PMC (JATS XML), PDF penerbit/penulis, halaman HTML buku terbuka (OTexts, Pressbooks), atau PDF ACM/ScienceDirect/bit-Tech lewat sesi peramban Playwright. Kutipan prosa diperiksa ulang secara otomatis terhadap teks hasil ekstraksi (build_rumus.py, pencocokan substring setelah normalisasi spasi, tanda kutip, dan pemenggalan kata); kutipan dari PDF pindaian atau gambar (ACM 1993-2000, Geng & Hamilton Tabel IV, Friedman 2001, Efron 1979, FPP3 Tabel 8.6, Gardner 2006 Tabel 1, Sihombing dkk. Pers. 1-3, Taufiq dkk. Pers. 1-3, Feistel & Wagner 2006, DiCiccio & Efron 1996, Ge dkk. 2010) diketik ulang dari gambar halaman dan diperiksa visual.

confirmed.concept: Rasio seduh (brew ratio) = massa air seduh dibagi massa kopi bubuk
confirmed.variables: R_brew: rasio seduh, tak berdimensi (gram air per gram kopi). M_w: massa air seduh yang dituangkan (g). M_g: massa kopi bubuk (dosis, g). Contoh resep V60 pada dokumen arahan: 15 g kopi dan 225 ml air ("1:15") memberi R_brew = 225/15 = 15, dengan asumsi 1 ml air setara 1 g.
confirmed.location_in_source: Bagian Theory, subbagian 'Definition sketch for full immersion brewing', Pers. (1) (Scientific Reports 11, artikel 6904; teks lengkap Europe PMC PMC7994670)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: Initially, a known mass of coffee grounds ( M_g ) and a known mass of hot water ( M_w ) is added to the brewer. The ratio of these masses is defined as the brew ratio, R_brew = M_w / M_g. (1)

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian 1 Introduction, hlm. 2169 (J. Food Sci. 88(5):2168-2177)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: These quantities are linked via the conservation of mass to the brew ratio Rbrew = mw / mg of water to coffee grounds, following the relationship: [...] Note that brew ratio is often expressed in terms of the mass of coffee grounds per mass of water, or less precisely in terms of the mass of coffee grounds per volume of water, which necessitates assumptions about the density of the water.

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian 04 'Terms and Definitions', hlm. 5 PDF (SCA Standard 310-2021)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Brew ratio. The ratio of coffee to water when preparing a brew. In this standard, brew ratio is expressed in grams of coffee per 1.000 kg of fresh water at 17±3°C (g/kg). The brew ratio used for testing in this standard is 55 g of coffee per 1.000 kg of fresh water unless stated otherwise.

confirmed.notes: Dua orientasi sama-sama tercetak di sumber: Liang dkk. (2021) dan Guinard dkk. (2023) memakai air/kopi (R_brew = M_w/M_g, mis. 15), sedangkan SCA 310-2021 memakai kopi per air (g kopi per kg air; standar 55 g/kg). Resep arahan '1:15' (kopi:air) setara R_brew = 15. Skripsi harus menyebut orientasi secara eksplisit dan konsisten dengan kalkulator (SPEC 5: air V60 = 15 x dosis). Konversi ml ke g mengandaikan massa jenis air kira-kira 1 g/ml; Guinard dkk. menyebut rasio per volume air 'less precisely' karena butuh asumsi massa jenis. Persamaan Liang ditranskripsikan dari MathML Europe PMC ke bentuk linear. Guinard dibaca dari salinan PDF unduhan Wiley (footer Wiley, OA CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) yang dihosting pages.uoregon.edu karena situs Wiley menolak unduhan skrip. Sitasi BINUS: Liang (3 penulis) memakai \citep*, Guinard (6 penulis) memakai \citep.

confirmed.concept: Kekuatan seduhan (TDS) sebagai fraksi massa padatan kopi terlarut dalam cairan seduhan
confirmed.requested_form: TDS = massa padatan terlarut / massa seduhan (fraksi massa)
confirmed.variables: TDS: total dissolved solids, fraksi massa padatan kopi terlarut (biasa dilaporkan dalam persen, TDS x 100%). M_d: massa padatan kopi yang terlarut dalam cairan (g). M_L: massa cairan seduhan yang mengandung padatan tersebut (g); pada model imersi Liang dkk. M_L = M_w + M_d (Pers. 10).
confirmed.original_attribution: Lockhart (1957), The Soluble Solids in Beverage Coffee as an Index to Cup Quality, Coffee Brewing Institute - dirujuk Batali dkk. (2020) dan Guinard dkk. (2023); tidak ada di pool.
confirmed.evidence_form: persamaan tercetak (Pers. 3b dan 10) + definisi verbal (Batali dkk.)
confirmed.location_in_source: Bagian Theory, subbagian 'Equilibrium desorption model', Pers. (3b) beserta kalimat sesudahnya dan Pers. (10) (Scientific Reports 11:6904; PMC7994670)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: For simplicity in relating theory to experimental observations, both mass concentrations are per unit mass of liquid, M_L , such that C_A = M_A / M_L , (3a) C_D = M_D / M_L . (3b) By this definition, C_D is equivalent to the TDS. [...] Note that M_L is not known a priori but it is readily related to the mass of water added and the mass of dissolved coffee species present in the brew, M_L = M_w + M_d . (10)

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Introduction, paragraf pertama (Scientific Reports 10:16450; PMC7536440)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Seminal work by Lockhart in 1957² related the quality of brewed coffee to two key metrics: the "brew strength," which is the mass fraction of soluble solids in the brew (commonly characterized as the total dissolved solids, or TDS), and the "extraction yield," which is the mass fraction of soluble solids removed from the coffee grounds (commonly referred to as the percent extraction, or PE).

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian 04 'Terms and Definitions', hlm. 5 PDF
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Brew strength. The amount of total dissolved solids (TDS) in the brew, expressed in percentage or in parts per million, and usually estimated using a coffee refractometer.

confirmed.notes: Liang dkk. menulis M_D pada Pers. (3b) dan M_d pada Pers. (10) dan (13) untuk besaran yang sama (massa padatan terlarut); skripsi cukup memakai satu simbol M_d. M_L adalah massa cairan (air + padatan terlarut), bukan massa air saja. Superskrip '2' pada kutipan Batali adalah nomor rujukan (Lockhart, 1957). TDS diukur tidak langsung dengan refraktometer (SCA 310-2021).

confirmed.concept: Rendemen ekstraksi (extraction yield / percent extraction) dari TDS, massa minuman, dan dosis kopi
confirmed.variables: EY: rendemen ekstraksi (fraksi atau %; disebut juga percent extraction, PE). TDS: fraksi massa padatan terlarut minuman (F02). M_bev: massa minuman yang dihasilkan (g; 'M_brew' pada Batali dkk., 'Yield' pada Moroney dkk.). M_dose: massa kopi bubuk (g; 'M_grounds' atau 'Dose').
confirmed.original_attribution: Ristenpart & Kuhl (2017), The Design of Coffee: An Engineering Approach - rujukan [3] Batali dkk. (2020); tidak ada di pool.
confirmed.location_in_source: Materials and methods, subbagian 'Physical measurements of coffee samples', Pers. (1) (Scientific Reports 10:16450; PMC7536440)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: The total delivered mass of the brewed coffee was measured after each brew, and the percent extraction was calculated³ as: PE = TDS × M_brew / M_grounds . (1)

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Introduction, Pers. (1) (PLOS ONE 14(7):e0219906; PMC6668809)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Baristas can now measure the extraction yield percentage through careful weighing of the mass of coffee used to make the espresso (the dose) and the mass of the espresso produced (the yield). [...] A digital refractometer is used to measure the TDS in the espresso liquid. The extraction percentage can then be worked out by the following equation: (Yield × TDS) / Dose = Extraction yield, (1)

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian 04 'Terms and Definitions', hlm. 5 PDF
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Brew yield (percent extraction). This is defined as the percentage in mass of the fresh coffee grounds which is extracted into the brew after the cycle is completed.

confirmed.notes: Sama dengan rumus sistem pakar di SPEC 7.4 (EY % = TDS % x beverage_g / dose_g). Rumus hanya menghitung padatan yang terbawa dalam minuman; padatan terlarut di cairan yang tertahan pada ampas tidak terhitung (lihat F04). Bila TDS dalam persen, EY juga dalam persen. Superskrip '3' pada kutipan Batali adalah nomor rujukan. Moroney dkk. memiliki 6 penulis sehingga memakai \citep tanpa bintang.

confirmed.concept: Neraca massa PE-TDS-rasio seduh dengan koreksi air yang tertahan di ampas (absorption/liquid retention ratio)
confirmed.variables: PE: percent extraction (rendemen ekstraksi, fraksi). TDS: fraksi massa padatan terlarut (F02). R_brew = m_w/m_g: rasio seduh air terhadap kopi (F01). R_abs: absorption ratio atau liquid retention ratio, massa air yang tertahan di ampas basah per massa kopi (sekitar 2,1).
confirmed.original_attribution: Ristenpart & Kuhl (2021) (tidak di pool) dan Liang dkk. (2021) (liang2021equilibrium), sebagaimana dirujuk Guinard dkk. (2023).
confirmed.location_in_source: Bagian 1 Introduction, hlm. 2169 (J. Food Sci. 88(5):2168-2177)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: These quantities are linked via the conservation of mass to the brew ratio Rbrew = mw / mg of water to coffee grounds, following the relationship: PE = TDS/(1 − TDS) (Rbrew − Rabs), where Rabs ≈2.1 is the "absorption ratio" or "liquid retention ratio" of water retained in the spent moist grounds (Ristenpart & Kuhl, 2021; Liang et al., 2021).

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian Theory, subbagian 'Extraction yield at equilibrium', Pers. (16)-(17); bagian Results (rasio retensi)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Specifically, from Eqs. (3b) and (10) the mass of dissolved solids is related to the TDS as, M_d = TDS/(1 − TDS) M_w , (16) and substitution into Eq. (13) yields E = TDS/(1 − TDS) R_brew . (17) [...] this brew ratio is less than the average retention ratio of 2.48±0.19 calculated from Eq. (24)

confirmed.notes: Dengan R_abs = 0 persamaan menjadi Pers. (17) Liang dkk. (imersi penuh; seluruh cairan dihitung). Nilai R_abs bergantung metode: Guinard dkk. memakai kira-kira 2,1, sedangkan Liang dkk. mengukur rasio retensi rata-rata 2,48 ± 0,19 pada seduhan imersi yang disaring. Asumsi SPEC 7.4 'massa minuman = air - 2 x dosis' setara R_abs = 2 (asumsi penulis; sebut sebagai pendekatan dengan rujukan ke Guinard dkk.). Perhitungan penulis (turunan, bukan kutipan): untuk resep V60 arahan (R_brew = 15) dengan R_abs = 2,1, PE 18-22% setara TDS sekitar 1,38-1,68%. Persamaan di PDF ditulis sebagai pecahan; di sini ditulis linear.

confirmed.concept: Rasio seduh espreso (brew ratio, BR) = massa kopi dalam puck dibagi massa espreso di cangkir
confirmed.requested_form: espresso brew ratio = beverage mass / dose (DIBALIK di sumber; lihat R01)
confirmed.variables: BR: rasio seduh espreso (tak berdimensi). m_kopi: massa kopi bubuk dalam puck/portafilter = dosis (g). m_espreso: massa espreso yang terekstraksi ke cangkir (g). Ristretto BR 1/1, espreso BR 1/2, lungo BR 1/3 (mis. puck 20 g dengan 40 g espreso = BR 1/2).
confirmed.evidence_form: definisi verbal + nilai BR dan perhitungan massa di Bagian 2.8.2
confirmed.location_in_source: Bagian 1 Introduction (paragraf kedua dan paragraf penutup) serta subbagian 2.8.2 'Calculation of Component Mass in EC Cup' (Foods 12(15):2871; PMC10418593)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: The ratio between the ground coffee mass in the puck and the extracted EC mass in the cup is called the brew ratio (BR). [...] for Ristretto (BR 1/1), Espresso (BR 1/2), and Espresso Lungo (BR 1/3). [...] Thus, beverage masses of 20 g, 40 g, and 60 g were chosen for the calculation to match the coffee puck mass of 20 ± 0.01 g and achieve the brew ratios of BR 1/1, BR 1/2, and BR 1/3.

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Introduction (PMC6668809)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Brewing recipes are thus typically given in terms of weight in (dose) and weight out (yield) (e.g. 18 g in –36 g out) along with the recommended shot time (the time it takes water to pass through the coffee bed).

confirmed.notes: Bentuk yang diminta (massa minuman / dosis) adalah KEBALIKAN definisi sumber: Schmieder dkk. mendefinisikan BR = massa kopi / massa espreso (1/2 untuk espreso); lihat rejected R01. Tidak ada sumber pool yang dibuka yang mencetak 'brew ratio = massa minuman / dosis' untuk espreso. Rekomendasi: tulis rasio espreso sebagai 'dosis : hasil = 1 : 2' (sesuai BR = 1/2), atau bila kalkulator menyimpan hasil/dosis = 2, sebut besaran itu 'rasio hasil (1/BR)' sebagai konvensi penulis. Orientasi ini juga berlawanan dengan F01 (air/kopi), jadi jangan mencampur simbol R_brew dan BR.

confirmed.concept: Faktor konversi resep = hasil (yield) yang dibutuhkan dibagi hasil resep asal
confirmed.requested_form: recipe conversion factor = desired yield / original yield
confirmed.variables: f: faktor konversi (>1 memperbesar, <1 memperkecil). Y_butuh: hasil yang dibutuhkan. Y_resep: hasil resep asal. Bila jumlah dan ukuran porsi sama-sama berubah, hasil total dihitung sebagai Y = n_porsi x s_porsi (jumlah porsi x ukuran porsi) untuk resep asal maupun resep baru.
confirmed.evidence_form: persamaan dalam kalimat (tanpa nomor) + langkah prosedur
confirmed.location_in_source: Bab 6 'Converting and Adjusting Recipes and Formulas' (bagian Trade Math), subbagian 'Finding Conversion Factors' (buku terbuka Pressbooks BCcampus, CC BY 4.0, tanpa nomor halaman)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: Obtain the conversion factor by dividing the required yield (from Step 2) by the old yield (from Step 1). That is, conversion factor = (required yield)/(recipe yield) or conversion factor = what you NEED ÷ what you HAVE. [...] Determine the total yield of the recipe by multiplying the number of portions and the size of each portion. Determine the required yield of the recipe by multiplying the new number of portions and the new size of each portion. Find the conversion factor by dividing the required yield (Step 2) by the recipe yield (Step 1).
confirmed.notes: Pemetaan ke SPEC 6: f = cup_ml / base_cup_ml (ukuran porsi) dan total = per cangkir x cups; mode dosis V60: f = dose_g / base_dose. Contoh 6 di sumber tidak konsisten (teks menyebut '60 portions', perhitungan '40 portions x 120 g per portion = 4800 g') - jangan disalin sebagai contoh. gisslen2025professional (pool) memuat subbab 'Converting Recipes', tetapi hanya daftar isinya yang dapat dibuka sehingga tidak dipakai sebagai bukti rumus.

confirmed.concept: Takaran bahan baru = takaran bahan asal x faktor konversi (penskalaan linier)
confirmed.requested_form: new quantity = old quantity x conversion factor
confirmed.variables: q_i^asal: takaran bahan ke-i pada resep asal (sebaiknya dalam satuan berat). f: faktor konversi (F06). q_i^baru: takaran bahan ke-i setelah konversi.
confirmed.evidence_form: definisi verbal + tabel contoh (Tabel 14 dan 16: Original Amount x Conversion factor = New Ingredient Amount)
confirmed.location_in_source: Bab 6, subbagian 'Adjusting Recipes Using Conversion Factors' dan 'Cautions when Converting Recipes'
confirmed.evidence_snippet: Now that you have the conversion factor, you can use it to adjust all the ingredients in the recipe. The procedure is to multiply the amount of each ingredient in the original recipe by the conversion factor. Before you begin, there is an important first step: Before converting a recipe, express the original ingredients by weight whenever possible. [...] However, a major exception is measuring liquids with a high sugar content, such as honey and syrup; these should always be measured by weight, not volume. [...] Spices and seasonings must be increased with caution as doubling or tripling the amount to satisfy a conversion factor can have negative consequences. [...] The fine adjustments that have to be made when converting a recipe can only be learned from experience, as there are no hard and fast rules.
confirmed.notes: Ini adalah baseline naive_scale di SPEC 6 (semua takaran x f x cups tanpa pembulatan/batasan). Kalimat 'Cautions' menjadi dasar teoretis perlunya aturan berbatasan (shot utuh, isi hingga penuh, pembulatan ke presisi takar); aturan berbatasan itu rancangan penulis, bukan dari sumber. Persamaan simbolik ditulis penulis dari kalimat prosedur (sumber tidak memberi persamaan bernomor).

confirmed.concept: Stok pengaman (safety stock) = Z x simpangan baku permintaan selama lead time, dengan σ_L = σ_d √L
confirmed.requested_form: SS = z x sigma_d x sqrt(L)
confirmed.variables: SS: stok pengaman (satuan bahan). Z: nilai distribusi normal baku sesuai tingkat layanan (mis. 1,65 untuk 95%). σ_d: simpangan baku permintaan (atau galat ramalan) harian. σ_L: simpangan baku permintaan selama lead time. L: lead time (hari).
confirmed.original_attribution: Silver, Pyke & Peterson (1998) - dirujuk Yigit & Esnaf (2023); tidak di pool (silver2016inventory edisi ke-4 ada di pool tetapi isinya tidak dapat dibuka).
confirmed.location_in_source: Bagian 3.5 'Metode Analisis Sistem' butir a 'Metode Safety Stock', Pers. (1)-(2), hlm. 2729; contoh hitung di Bagian 4.3 'Pembahasan', hlm. 2734 (SISTEMASI 14(6):2724-2737)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: Proses ini dihitung menggunakan Persamaan (1),(2), yang dirancang untuk menentukan jumlah safety stock berdasarkan standar deviasi kebutuhan harian dan waktu tunggu pemesanan, dijelaskan dengan rumus dibawah ini. σL = σd x √L (1) Keterangan: σd : Standar deviasi dari Tingkat kebutuhan (unit) L : Lead Time (Waktu tunggu pemesanan) Selanjutnya menghitung safety stock berdasarkan Z-Score untuk menghitung hasil cadangan persediaan yang dijelaskan pada Persamaan (2) berikut. Safety Stock = Z x σL (2) [...] [hlm. 2734] σL = σd × √L = 1,2 × √4= 1,2 × 2 = 2,4 [...] Safety Stock = Z × σL = 1,65 × 2,4 = 3,96 ≈ 4 kg

additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: rpx covers the total period of the review period and lead time of the product x (Silver, Pyke and Peterson, 1998). drpx = dtx * rpx (1) σrpx = σx * √rpx . (2) [...] The common assumption used for the calculation of safety stock is that these errors have a normal distribution with no bias (that is, the average value of the error is zero) and a known standard deviation (σrpx) for a period of rp (Silver et al., 1998). [...] ssx = kx * σrpx , (3)

confirmed.notes: Keterangan Pers. (2) di Taufiq dkk. salah susun (σ diberi arti 'Nilai dari distribusi normal standar ...' dan L diberi arti 'Simpangan baku ... selama lead time'); makna yang benar: Z = nilai normal baku sesuai tingkat layanan (contoh sumber: 95%, Z = 1,65), σ_L = simpangan baku permintaan selama lead time. Taufiq dkk. menyatakan σ_d sebagai simpangan baku kebutuhan harian; SPEC 7.3 memakai simpangan baku galat ramalan harian tingkat bahan dari backtest - sejalan dengan asumsi Yigit & Esnaf bahwa galat ramalan berdistribusi normal tanpa bias. Pada kebijakan order-up-to (R,S), Yigit & Esnaf memakai periode risiko rp = R + L (σ √(R+L)); SPEC memakai √L untuk ROP maupun S (evaluate_restock.py melaporkan sensitivitas √(L+R)) - sebutkan sebagai penyederhanaan. Tanda kali 'x' pada kutipan Taufiq adalah huruf x di sumber.

confirmed.concept: Titik pemesanan ulang (reorder point) = stok pengaman + lead time x rata-rata pemakaian
confirmed.requested_form: ROP = expected demand over lead time + SS
confirmed.variables: ROP: titik pesan ulang (satuan bahan). SS: stok pengaman (F09). L: lead time (hari). d̄: rata-rata pemakaian bahan per hari (dilambangkan Q oleh Taufiq dkk.).
confirmed.original_attribution: Silver, Pyke & Peterson (1998) - lihat F09; tidak di pool.
confirmed.location_in_source: Bagian 3.5 butir b 'Metode ROP (Reorder Point)', Pers. (3), hlm. 2729-2730; contoh hitung hlm. 2734
confirmed.evidence_snippet: Nilai Reorder Point (ROP) dihitung dengan menjumlahkan safety stock dan hasil perkalian antara lead time dan rata-rata pemakaian bahan baku, sebagaimana ditunjukkan pada Persamaan (3). ROP = safety stock + (leadtime × Q) (3) [hlm. 2730] Keterangan: ROP : Reorder point (Unit) Leadtime : 7 hari Q : Pemakaian rata-rata bahan baku per m [...] [hlm. 2734] ROP = (5 × 4) + 4 = 20 + 4 = 24 kg

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian 3, Pers. (1), hlm. 511
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: Eq. (1) and Eq. (2) represent the mean and standard deviation of demand during the risk period (rp). [...] drpx = dtx * rpx (1)

confirmed.notes: Legenda Pers. (3) memuat 'Leadtime : 7 hari' dan 'per m' (terpotong), sedangkan contoh hitung memakai L = 4 hari; pakai simbol, bukan angka legenda. SPEC 7.3 memakai ROP = D(L) + SS dengan D(L) = jumlah ramalan permintaan bahan selama L hari; untuk permintaan rata-rata konstan D(L) = d̄ x L (bentuk sumber). Penggantian d̄ x L dengan jumlah ramalan adalah rancangan penulis - tandai 'dirumuskan penulis berdasarkan Taufiq dkk. (2025)'. Pada simulasi, kebijakan (b) 'static ROP' memakai μ x L + SS (bentuk sumber).

confirmed.concept: Tingkat order-up-to S pada peninjauan periodik (R, S) = permintaan rata-rata selama periode risiko (R + L) + stok pengaman; pesanan menaikkan persediaan kembali ke S
confirmed.requested_form: order-up-to level S dan Q = S - inventory position (periodic review)
confirmed.variables: S: tingkat order-up-to. d̄: rata-rata permintaan per periode. R: periode peninjauan (hari). L: lead time (hari); R + L = periode risiko (risk period). SS: stok pengaman untuk periode risiko. Q: kuantitas pesanan saat peninjauan. IP: posisi persediaan saat peninjauan (stok di tangan + pesanan dalam perjalanan).

confirmed.concept: Skor System Usability Scale (SUS)
confirmed.requested_form: SUS = 2.5 x [sum odd (x_i - 1) + sum even (5 - x_i)]
confirmed.variables: x_i: posisi skala jawaban butir ke-i (1 = sangat tidak setuju sampai 5 = sangat setuju). Butir ganjil bernada positif, butir genap bernada negatif. Kontribusi tiap butir 0-4; skor SUS 0-100; skor per butir tidak bermakna sendiri.
confirmed.original_attribution: Brooke (1996) (brooke1996sus)
confirmed.location_in_source: Methods, subbagian 'SUS Score' (JMIR mHealth uHealth 10(8):e37290; PMC9437782)
confirmed.evidence_snippet: A SUS score is computed using the 10 Likert ratings that is typically completed by a user after having been exposed to the system for a period of time. The process for computing a SUS score is as follows: Subtract 1 from the user's Likert ratings for odd-numbered items or questions. Subtract the user's Likert ratings from 5 for even-numbered items. Each item score will range from 0 to 4. Sum the numbers and multiply the total by 2.5. This calculation will provide a range of possible SUS scores from 0 to 100 [7].

additional_evidence.location_in_source: Bagian 'Scoring SUS' (naskah bab penulis, salinan AHRQ, hlm. 5 PDF; bab terbit dalam Usability Evaluation in Industry, hlm. 207-212 menurut pool)
additional_evidence.evidence_snippet: SUS yields a single number representing a composite measure of the overall usability of the system being studied. Note that scores for individual items are not meaningful on their own. To calculate the SUS score, first sum the score contributions from each item. Each item's score contribution will range from 0 to 4. For items 1,3,5,7,and 9 the score contribution is the scale position minus 1. For items 2,4,6,8 and 10, the contribution is 5 minus the scale position. Multiply the sum of the scores by 2.5 to obtain the overall value of SU. SUS scores have a range of 0 to 100.
